newsitem.title: UK: Cathay Pacific ex-UK cargo fuel surcharge.
newsitem.headline: Cathay Pacific ex-UK cargo fuel surcharge.

text.p: Cathay Pacific Airways Ltd will apply an ex-UK cargo fuel surcharge of five pence a kg with effect from November 25, a cargo executive told Reuters.

The decision follows the announcement of surcharges, or in some cases rate increases, by airlines including west European majors, averaging US10 cents a kilo or the equivalent in local currency, starting with Lufthansa Cargo AG on October 25.
British Airways Plc set the trend for ex-UK increases when it announced a six pence a kg surcharge -- one pence more than Cathay -- on October 31 with effect from November 8.
